about: Published target (rule-curve) elevations of reservoirs, matched to dams by name. Elevations in metres as published by the dam owner. Add entries with a citation; 'targets' may be empty when only a description is published.

targets.label: Upper operating limit, maximum desired level
Lower rule curve minimum
targets.when: Oct 1 - Mar 1, early winter and late fall

reservoirs.notes: Rule curve set for low-flow augmentation to the upper Grand River (Legatt target 0.42 m3/s). Mar 1 - Sep 30: operating range between the upper and lower rule curves. Oct 1 - Mar 1: upper curve from the Luther Marsh Management Plan (1991). The reservoir may operate below 480.6 m.
reservoirs.citation: Grand River Conservation Authority, 2016. A Framework for Identifying Indicators of Water Resource Conditions (reservoir yield technical report), May 2016, Appendix 2 and Appendix 4.

reservoirs.notes: Rule curve revised February 2004; balances spring flood storage and summer low-flow augmentation.
reservoirs.citation: Grand River Conservation Authority, 2016. A Framework for Identifying Indicators of Water Resource Conditions (reservoir yield technical report), May 2016, Tables 2 and 3.
